Wondrous Item (Artifact), requires attunement by a Warlock

A black iron choker adorned with a hexagonal amber gemstone engraved with infernal runes. The gemstone glows softly like a banked ember and grows brighter whenever its wearer achieves a significant victory.

Only the wearer hears the voice within.

The voice belongs to Bel.

Former Archduke of Avernus.

General of the Blood War.

Bel does not see the wearer as a servant.

He sees potential.

The Choker serves as both a gift and an evaluation.

Dormant Powers

Bel's Protection

You gain resistance to Psychic damage.

Bel has fortified your mind against outside influence.

Commanding Presence

You gain proficiency in Persuasion.

If already proficient, gain expertise instead.

Strategic Insight

As a reaction after rolling an attack roll, saving throw, or ability check, you may add 1d6 to the result.

You may use this feature a number of times equal to your proficiency bonus per long rest.

Infernal Audience

Once per long rest, you may ask Bel a single question.

Bel's answer is always truthful.

His answer is rarely complete.

Personality

Bel is calm, measured, and analytical.

He rarely compliments anyone.

When he does, it matters.

"Acceptable."

"I've seen worse."

"That was inefficient."

"A reasonable decision."

"Well executed."
